name: An Undelivered Letter
summary: Long-forgotten mail lies in Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn, carrying a critical clue to Stalvan Mistmantle's past.

sections.title: A Midnight Flight
sections.body: Years ago, a storm sent a traveling courier to the Lion's Pride Inn for shelter. Near midnight, the frightened messenger fled downstairs in his sleeping clothes and vanished into the pouring rain, never to return. On the second floor, he left a chest of belongings, including a letter from Stalvan Mistmantle addressed to an estate in Stormwind City's Canal District.

sections.title: Tracing the Scholar
sections.body: The unopened letter lay untouched in the inn's upper rooms until modern investigators began retracing Stalvan's steps through Elwynn Forest. Taking the lost parchment to Caretaker Folsom in the capital carries the mystery from the inn's quiet halls to the heart of Stormwind.

faq.q: Where is the undelivered letter found?
faq.answer: The letter rests in a storage chest on the second floor of Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn, at the foot of a bed in one of the guest rooms.

faq.q: Why was the letter never delivered?
faq.answer: The courier carrying the letter took shelter at the Lion's Pride Inn during a rainstorm. Around midnight, he panicked, ran downstairs in his nightclothes, and vanished into the storm, leaving his chest and its contents behind.
Stalvan Mistmantle wrote the letter. He had spent several nights at the inn around the same time as the frightened courier.

faq.q: Where is the letter supposed to go?
faq.answer: The letter is addressed to the Canal District of Stormwind City. It can be brought to Caretaker Folsom near the Park.

angles.text: Tracing the courier's forgotten route leads investigators from Goldshire's pastoral heart to Stormwind City's upper-class quarters.
